scenario: A REST API with user and order endpoints needs a behavior-focused test strategy that assigns each behavior slice to the smallest sufficient seam and test level.
prompt: define a test strategy for POST /users, GET /users/:id, POST /orders, GET /orders/:id using vitest; assign each behavior slice to unit, integration, or e2e with justification, and list intentional coverage gaps with rationale.
context: repo skills-quirk on branch main, node 24
the system surface exposes POST /users, GET /users/:id, POST /orders, GET /orders/:id
the test stack is vitest with expect assertions and GitHub Actions CI
each behavior slice must cite its public behavior source and seam assignment justification
internal implementation details and private methods must not be tested through public seams
test pyramid applies: most unit, fewer integration, fewest e2e
grounding: .agents/skills/delivery/testing/SKILL.md#Seam selection rules - smallest seam, unit for pure logic, integration for cross-module, e2e for critical journeys
.agents/skills/delivery/testing/SKILL.md#Evidence requirements for test strategy - behavior source, seam justification, level rationale, coverage gaps
.agents/skills/delivery/testing/SKILL.md#Guardrails - test pyramid, avoid over-mocking, behavior-focused, no silent gaps

instructionFollowing.criterion: The public behavior inventory is complete for the declared scope with observable outcomes and preconditions.

levels.4: every endpoint and behavior is listed with an observable outcome and preconditions
levels.2: most behaviors are listed but some lack outcomes or preconditions
levels.0: no public behavior inventory is produced

instructionFollowing.criterion: Each behavior slice has a seam assignment with justification for why a smaller seam is insufficient.

levels.4: every slice has unit/integration/e2e assignment plus a one-sentence justification
levels.2: seams are assigned but justifications are missing or weak

instructionFollowing.criterion: Each test level assignment includes risk-based justification and follows the test pyramid.

levels.4: level assignments carry risk rationale and unit > integration > e2e distribution
levels.2: levels are assigned but risk rationale or pyramid balance is missing
levels.0: no level assignments or the pyramid is inverted

instructionFollowing.criterion: Intentional coverage gaps are enumerated with rationale and revisit triggers.

levels.4: gaps are named with rationale and a revisit trigger or owner
levels.2: gaps are listed without rationale or triggers

goalCompletion.criterion: Tests assert on public behavior and observable outcomes, not internal implementation details.

levels.4: no private methods, internal state shapes, or implementation-specific returns are asserted
levels.2: mostly behavior-focused with minor internal-detail assertions
levels.0: tests assert on private methods or internal state

goalCompletion.criterion: No behavior slice within declared scope is silently uncovered; every slice is covered or an intentional gap.

levels.4: every slice is covered or explicitly listed as an intentional gap with rationale
levels.2: most slices are covered but some are silently omitted

goalCompletion.criterion: Mocking is limited to the boundary of the unit under test; no cross-seam mocking.

levels.4: mocks only appear at unit boundaries, never across seams
levels.2: mostly boundary mocking with one cross-seam mock
levels.0: cross-seam or deep internal mocking is used

goalCompletion.criterion: The structured test strategy result is returned and validated with blockers documented if any.

levels.4: testStrategy, seamGuidance, and coverageBoundaries are all present and validated
levels.2: the result is present but validation is skipped or fields are missing

check.note: the test strategy artifact must contain all three output fields
all three test levels must be referenced in the strategy
negative control: no assertions on private methods, internal state, or implementation details

assertions.note: the strategy must contain sufficient detail beyond a trivial stub

check.criterion: Does every behavior slice have a seam assignment with justification for why a smaller seam is insufficient?

levels.pass: all slices have seam assignments with justifications
levels.fail: one or more slices lack a seam or justification

check.criterion: Do tests assert on public behavior and observable outcomes rather than internal implementation details?

levels.pass: all assertions target public behavior only
levels.fail: private methods or internal state are asserted

check.criterion: Are intentional coverage gaps enumerated with rationale and revisit triggers?

levels.pass: gaps are named with rationale and triggers
levels.fail: gaps are missing or lack rationale
